text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Nǐ hǎo, Trainer! I have a small favor 
to ask, do you have a moment?
choice_data_list: Yeah, if it's something I can do.
Yeah, if it's something I can do.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's not anything too difficult. I 
just want you to be the cameraman for a 
video message to my friends overseas!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Since I'm here, I wanted to not just say 
hello, but introduce you to the academy 
and the people I'm close with."
choice_data_list: If that's the case, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Then this is it. I'm counting 
on you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Nǐ hǎo! Hello! This hollow is one of the 
academy's famous spots!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Letting out the feelings you can't tell 
anyone else clears away all the gloom and 
sharpens your mind!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"In our cafeteria, students gather for all 
sorts of activities outside of lunchtime, 
too—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's all for today's "Helpful Kitasan 
Consultation Room"! Feel free to come by 
anytime!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Kura-chan and Trainer! Are you 
filming something?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just a video message for a friend 
overseas♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone! This is Kitasan. She's a 
wonderful girl and super strong at racing. 
Plus, she's a bright and kind neighborhood 
helper!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hello, nice to meet you! Kura-chan might 
be saying all that, but honestly, she 
helps me out a lot too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Even the other day, they translated fan 
letters from overseas for me—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that passionate letter! Just reading 
it gave me energy too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I'd like to write a reply 
sometime soon, so would you mind giving me 
a hand?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: No problem, with pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks! ...And so, as you can see, 
Kura-chan is always looking out for me♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Next up, this is the outdoor stage. As you 
can see, it's a place for dance and music 
performances.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hello, amore! I heard the news, you're 
filming a video message for a dear friend, 
aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Right now, they're showing 
the outdoor stage—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fantastico! Then let's have a session! A 
present for your amores!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Wah, yes, please! It's an honor to 
introduce the academy's top musician♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The honor is all mine! To be praised by a 
musicista of your caliber!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, from here on, let us converse through 
a passionate melodía that speaks far more 
eloquently than mere words!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah! Bravissimo!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Your usual performances are magnificent as 
well, but today's tone resonates with a 
deep amore for your friend!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Crown's Trainer! Capture those two 
intertwining beams of light onto film!

I made sure to capture a great photo of 
the two of them happily playing their 
instruments!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, how was it? Did you get a bit 
of a feel for the academy's atmosphere?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
They must be watching on their phones or 
computers. Right now, I might only be 
inside a tiny screen, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, I'll deliver the thrill of the 
race from an even bigger screen. 
Definitely!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Because the grand stage is the only place 
truly fitting for a crown!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's time for training! That's all 
for today! Bye-bye, see you next time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks! I've been wanting to take 
this picture for so long, you really 
helped me out!!
choice_data_list: I hope your friends like it!
I hope your friends will be pleased!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was glad to be able to introduce 
the academy and everyone I'm so proud of.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I hope people can see that I'm surrounded 
by truly wonderful folks!
choice_data_list:
A lot of them have guts and are really 
straightforward.

A lot of them have guts and are really 
straightforward, aren't they?

Girls with such powerful personalities are 
so interesting, huh!

Girls with such powerful personalities are 
so interesting, aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I hope people can see that I'm surrounded 
by truly wonderful folks!

A lot of them have guts and are really

A lot of them have guts and are really

Girls with such powerful personalities are

Girls with such powerful personalities are 
so interesting, aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's precisely why we can have such 
a delightfully serious showdown in our 
races!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we head off to training? I 
can't let the others beat me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, every day is thrilling♪ You 
won't find many places as fun as this!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, Trainer, I'm counting 
on your help filming again♪
